# Doppel 1.1.4
- Rebuilds instances again on ChatGPT 26.818 and later. The previous version could not patch the newest ChatGPT layout, so instances failed with "Patching the instance OAuth callback routing failed" and would not start. - Recognises the reworked deep-link handling in current ChatGPT builds without pinning to one release, so a routine ChatGPT update no longer strands your instances.

# Doppel 1.1.3
- Fixes instance creation and rebuilding, which failed outright on ChatGPT 26.810 and later. - Notices when ChatGPT has updated itself and left managed instances on an older version, instead of reporting everything as up to date. - Offers to rebuild just the instances that are behind, from the ChatGPT app already installed: nothing is downloaded, ChatGPT itself keeps running, and instances that already match are left open. - No longer offers to install a version that is already installed, which used to fail with "is not newer than the installed build".

# Doppel 1.1.2
- Keeps the built-in Browser assignment aligned with the ChatGPT profile that is actually running. - Can adopt an already-running official ChatGPT profile without restarting it. - Asks before quitting ChatGPT when a Browser reassignment requires it, with a reminder to save unfinished drafts. - Shows assignment mismatches and unmanaged Browser sessions directly in the Doppel menu.
